steps.en: The confirmed reduction is saved in the system
steps.id: Reduction yang dikonfirmasi tersimpan di sistem
steps.why_en: Saving works, but one related fix is still pending UAT.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan berjalan, tetapi satu perbaikan terkait masih menunggu UAT.

steps.en: The system tells the officer the reduction succeeded
steps.id: Sistem memberi tahu officer bahwa reduction berhasil
steps.why_en: A success reply goes to the other system; no screen here shows it to the officer.
steps.why_id: Balasan sukses dikirim ke sistem lain; tidak ada layar di sini yang menampilkannya ke officer.

steps.en: The officer knows when the reduction was not applied
steps.id: Officer tahu jika reduction tidak berhasil diterapkan
steps.why_en: Failure replies go to the other system; no screen here shows them to the officer.
steps.why_id: Balasan gagal dikirim ke sistem lain; tidak ada layar di sini yang menampilkannya ke officer.
